in_marathi.name: Gulzarilal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lover of flowers
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gulzarilal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who enjoys and cherishes the beauty and fragrance of flowers. In Hindu mythology, Gulzarilal is a name for Lord Krishna, who is often depicted playing the flute, which represents the essence of love.
